declarations.docstring: A nonzero submodule satisfying the displayed closure condition contains the image of an injective map from a simple module that intertwines the indicated group-indexed maps.
For every general-linear-group index, the displayed map carries each polynomial in the total-degree-restricted collection to another member of that collection.
A nonzero submodule that is finite-dimensional over the field contains a simple submodule.
Simplicity of a subrepresentation as a submodule implies simplicity of its associated representation module.
The module of a subrepresentation's associated representation is linearly equivalent to its underlying submodule.
